items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: My mother liked possibly the songs of Gracie Fields... we are very, Bobby and I listen to a lot of Gracie Fields.

ctx.x: Do you recall what kind of music your parents listened to?

Oh yes. My father’s favorite songs, one of the songs he sang was “The Music Goes Round and Round” and comes out here. My mother liked possibly the songs of Gracie Fields and sort of the songs that were on the radio. It was mostly the popular music of the ‘30s, Noel Coward and so on. Interestingly enough, we are very, Bobby and I listen to a lot of Gracie Fields. When Bob was asked about his favorite singers he said — not in jazz — one was Janet Baker and the great English — I suppose you’d call her an opera…
So did you need to search out other musicians a few years later, so that you could get to sing?
